Question B-006-011-003.

Why the correct answer is right: Start with a half-wave value: 143 / 21.1 = 6.78 m. A director is slightly shorter; 0.95 x 6.78 = 6.44 m.

Per-choice notes:
- sourceIndex 0: "6.44 metres": Correct. A director is shorter than the driven element; 0.95 x (143 / 21.1) rounds to 6.44 metres.
- sourceIndex 1: "7.11 metres": This is longer than the half-wave driven value, so it fits a reflector idea better than a director.
- sourceIndex 2: "3.38 metres": This is about a quarter-wave value, not a Yagi director length.
- sourceIndex 3: "3.55 metres": This is still around a quarter-wave length, not the slightly-shorter-than-half-wave director.
